organon:Entity.reason: Supplied Participant indices stand for distinct Entities; canonical identity and Persistence are not constructed.

organon:Perception.reason: The supplied response function is not a canonical Perception witness.

organon:Interpretation.reason: The supplied response function is not a canonical Interpretation witness.

organon:Difference.reason: Each scoped sample carries a contrast producing an unequal response in the same context; the contrast may vary across samples.

organon:State.reason: A supplied target-state trace has two unequal ordered samples in Scope. No uninterrupted continuity between samples is proved.

organon:Representation.reason: Target-state alternatives are not joined to canonical Representation or Denotation.

organon:CausalContribution.reason: Holding context fixed in a supplied response model does not construct canonical temporal Causal Contribution or establish a physical mechanism.

organon:Claim.reason: The limit on normative and epistemic Claims is not encoded by this sensitivity theorem.

organon:Truth.reason: No Truth predicate or truth anti-entailment is proved by the local response model.

organon:Relation.reason: The exact Entity-State target relation remains in the historical finite-channel projection.

AC-D3.reason: The historical finite Attention field does not establish revised persistent directed Attention. This contract proves only the preserved target and channel joins, not the revised Attention-to-Action mechanism.

organon:Entity.reason: The record-independent local classifier distinguishes participants; canonical numerical identity remains open.

organon:Action.reason: An organized local action channel does not construct canonical boundary-crossing Action.

organon:CausalContribution.reason: Historical snapshot organization does not establish the revised canonical Attention-to-Action causal join.

organon:Relation.reason: The actor-target inequality and typed protection witness represent the directed Respect relation.

organon:Action.reason: The scoped constrained Transformation is the formal Action projection.

organon:Entity.reason: The local participant classifier receives only the identity Invariant and Boundary, so current-State and Persistence-record changes cannot affect classification. The finite witness distinguishes Boundary admission with the same identity criterion and full history. Equal classification does not entail one Entity; Boundary difference need not entail otherness under every classifier. Canonical numerical individuation, especially across Boundary changes, remains AC-G1.

organon:Boundary.reason: The boundary constructor of RespectProtection carries the exact Boundary-preservation projection.

organon:Agency.reason: The agency constructor carries a nonempty admitted family of identity-preserving options.

organon:Capability.reason: The self-determination constructor carries two distinct admitted identity-preserving options.

organon:Invariant.reason: Every protection branch carries target identity preservation obligations for the protected options.

formal_contract.reason: trackingNeedNotDetectEveryDifference gives a narrow-response countermodel; canonical Perception, Interpretation, and causal parity remain open. The old partial-ratio countermodel does not prove revised C41.

statements.subject: Attention is normatively and epistemically neutral

formal_contract.reason: Benefit, consent, morality, accuracy, and purpose lack closed-world predicates in the formal reduct.
Competence, wantedness, benefit, and harm lack formal predicates suitable for nonvacuous countermodels.

statements.subject: Respect is not agreement or affection

formal_contract.reason: Agreement, affection, obedience, and noninterference remain outside the current formal vocabulary.

Revised Attention and Care require canonical causal, participant, and perceptual/interpretive joins. Respect retains its local option and participant projections. Historical finite measurements do not discharge these gates.
No empirical application follows from the finite formal witnesses without a separate evidence-bearing Specification.
